name: N-body example
title: Synthetic hot Jupiter with a companion near the 2:1 resonance: 72 mid-transit times
notes: Simulated: 72 mid-transit times of a 1.17 M Jup planet at 2.797 d over 1110 days. The O − C on the Timing tab shows a sinusoid of about 20 orbits (57 d). “Search for an unseen companion” under Dynamics simulates companions on a grid of mass and period and finds the 0.1 M Jup planet near the 2:1 resonance that causes it; “Add it as a planet and fit” then samples its mass with the N-body model.
